scenes.title: Welcome
lines: Madison Park is moving to HomeownerHub.

lines.text: One easy place for your dues, your requests, and your news.

scenes.title: Step 1: Sign in
lines: Open the invitation email from HomeownerHub, sent by your board, and tap the button.
That signs you in. No password needed.
Next time, tap Email me a link. Or choose a password.

scenes.title: Step 2: Add it to your phone
lines: Add it to your home screen, so it opens like any app.

lines.text: On iPhone, use Safari. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

lines: On Android, use Chrome. Tap the menu.

lines.text: Then tap Add to Home screen, or Install app.
Tap Dues to see what you owe, and your statement.
Tap Pay to see how your board takes payment.

scenes.title: Ask the board
lines: Need something fixed? Tap Requests, then New support request.

lines.text: Write a note, and tap Send request.

scenes.title: Book a space
lines: To book the clubhouse or the pool, tap Community, then Book a space.

lines.text: Pick a space, a day, and a time.

lines: Then check your booking, and tap Book it.

lines.text: On Home, you will find Announcements and Documents.
Under Community, answer polls and talk with your neighbors.
Stuck? Tap the Help button. It says Hello, and your first name.
Or tap Ask, to chat with your assistant.

scenes.title: You are ready
lines: Your board is glad to help.
